To foster skill practice in sustainable and organic gardening, Alice can engage with her community through several effective methods. Joining local community gardens allows for hands-on experience and direct observation of established techniques. Participating in workshops or classes offered by botanical gardens or extension services provides structured learning opportunities. Online forums and social media groups dedicated to organic gardening can facilitate knowledge sharing and troubleshooting. Additionally, attending local farmers' markets or seed swaps helps build connections with experienced growers and provides access to heirloom seeds. Volunteering at environmental organizations or conservation projects can also deepen practical skills while contributing to the community.
